findings: TDD red check (packet note: checks passed before the builder ran, because implementation code from earlier attempts was already on the branch): reproduced independently by copying tests/test_continuous_run_accounting.py into a detached worktree of merge base 5354c7130e116658cc31dec270738ffaf2de67d6. Result: Ran 19 tests, FAILED (failures=17). Every S1 to S8 test fails on missing behaviour (no report.json, no checkpoint, no render_swimlane, no atomic rename), not on an import error. Only the two S9 guard tests pass at baseline, which is what they should do. The suite does exercise the new behaviour.

Reran on the final tree (P-12): python -m unittest tests.test_continuous_run_accounting gives Ran 19 tests, OK. The full check python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' gives Ran 760 tests, FAILED (failures=5, skipped=6) in the raw CI environment and Ran 760 tests, OK (skipped=6) with GITHUB_ACTOR, GITHUB_ACTIONS and GITHUB_ACTOR_ID unset. This matches the builder and test-writer reports exactly.

Test accounting (P-13) is complete and checks out: the baseline is 741 tests at merge base 5354c71. One file was added, tests/test_continuous_run_accounting.py, with 19 tests, so 760 = 741 + 19. No existing test file was edited: git diff --name-status --diff-filter=MD 5354c71 -- tests is empty. The only edit this run was to the new file's S9 test, and it is justified because spec R4.2/S9 now names the merge base rather than HEAD.

Scenario mapping is complete. S1 to S9 each have at least one test with the scenario id in the method name and docstring, and the module docstring holds a scenario map. The R4 items (a) to (d) map to test_s1_budget_death_mid_builder_leaves_complete_report, test_s2_station_timeout_death_is_recorded / test_s2_uncaught_error_death_is_recorded, test_s3_final_report_is_last_checkpoint_plus_verdict and test_s5_sigterm_completes_the_record.

The tests are real. They drive the real anvil.runner.run_pipeline on the real pipelines/sdlc-default.json, using a scripted fake runtime only at the model edge. They read report.json from disk and call the real line_comment.render, statuspage.render_status_page and render_swimlane. S5 sends real SIGTERM/SIGINT to a child process. S6 observes atomicity by wrapping os.replace/os.rename, not by mocking the runner. The assertions are specific: exact exit_status values, BUILDER_TOKENS 6359529, the expected measured total computed through summarize_steps, the cap, not_run for every unreached station, and cost total equal to the sum of measured steps.

Minor gap, non-blocking and already disclosed by the builder: no test covers the R2.4 branch where the in-flight station exposes no usage and the record must carry station_usage_reason. A fake runtime could raise ExecutorError with no usage while an earlier station's usage crosses the cap, or a small max_run_tokens could be used, so this is testable. It should be added in follow-up work.
Minor gap, non-blocking: only the pre-review checks gate stop has a test (test_s8_checks_gate_stop). The pre-deploy gate stop path is implemented but has no test.

Pre-existing, outside this order: the 5 failures in the protected tests test_autonomous_line.TestHumanGate (3 tests) and test_governed_delivery.TestApprovalPolicy (2 tests) depend on the environment. With GITHUB_ACTOR set, --by identities are refused. They fail the same way at the merge base, so this is a test-isolation finding for the owner, not a regression from this change.
